issues.description: The problem materials are inconsistent about the type used to hold animals in Farm. The UML diagram shows animals: List<Animal> (implying a List), but the Part 3 textual instructions explicitly require a Set implemented with a HashSet (and initialized in the no-arg constructor). The provided solution implements animals as a List (ArrayList). This mismatch (UML vs. textual instructions vs. solution) will confuse students about which collection type to use and whether duplicates must be prevented, and may cause tests or expected behavior (uniqueness) to be unclear or fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intended collection type consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Either: (A) Update the problem statement UML and the textual instructions to require a List (and adjust the note about uniqueness), or (B) change the solution (and any template hints) to use a Set<Animal> (HashSet) for the animals field, update imports and getter/setter signatures accordingly, and ensure singFarmSong, addAnimal, and feedAllAnimals iterate over the Set. Prefer option B if uniqueness is pedagogically intended; otherwise align all artifacts to use List.
